source_caption:
Ted is a comedy starring Mark Wahlberg and Seth MacFarlane, who also voices the teddy bear. The story follows a man whose childhood wish brought his teddy bear to life—but years later, that bear (Ted) is a foul-mouthed, irresponsible adult who causes chaos in his life.

The film mixes crude humor with a surprisingly emotional story about friendship and growing up. Its success led to a sequel, Ted 2, continuing the same outrageous comedy style.
